notes.title: Beta closed
notes.notes:
I let the beta run way over (for weeks instead of days) because I was busy with my Kickstarter. With the campaign complete, I'm turning the beta off. Thanks to everyone who played, especially those who sent feedback and/or transcripts.

The game will return to Steam (in a long time!) in its completely developed form.

-Wade

notes.title: Beta working again
notes.notes:
Yep, my recent fiddling behind-the-scenes seems to have fixed the problem.

I'm very sorry for the inconvenience, and will be running the beta an extra day and a half at least to make up for the time lost.

notes.title: Join the Andromeda Acolytes beta: Pick a team and play for prizes on the Discord
notes.notes:
[b]Andromeda Acolytes[/b] is launching on Kickstarter on August 3 – but first it's going to an exclusive Steam beta test from July 30 to August 2.

To sign up for the beta, all you have to do is join the [url=https://discord.gg/X4yJWVCGHy]Andromeda Acolytes Discord[/url] and pick a team – MC, Remotes or Phadra.

[b]Play for Steam game prizes across three weeks of skill and chance-based adventuring competitions in the lead-up. Everyone who gets involved on Discord will get a Steam key to the four-day beta when it's time.[/b]

I hope to see you there.

-Wade
